'''Xizor's laboratory''' was a installation owned by the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] in the [[Factory District]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] where his [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] worked on brainwashing techniques and [[Human replica droid]]s. Its occupants were killed by [[feral droid]]s in 19 BBY. Xizor later took the captive [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kaird]] and [[10-4TO]] there.
